Why Choose A Diamond Contractor

When it comes to your home's heating and air conditioning needs, choosing the right contractor can seem like a daunting task. Fortunately, Mitsubishi Electric Heating & Air Conditioning has done the legwork for you.

Mitsubishi Electric Heating & Air Conditioning has been a leader in ductless and ducted heat pump technology, ensuring that contractors who choose to stay at the forefront of the industry have every opportunity to do so.

Mitsubishi Electric Heating & Air Conditioning Diamond Contractors receive ongoing training and education on the latest ductless and ducted systems that Mitsubishi Electric has to offer. This commitment to continuous learning ensures that every installation is completed using the most current techniques and best practices.

As a Diamond Contractor, we take pride in delivering exceptional HVAC craftsmanship and adhering to the highest industry standards. Our goal is to provide uncompromised comfort for your home while treating your property with the same care and respect we would our own.

Heating and cooling problems can quickly disrupt comfort at home or work. Poor airflow, rising energy bills, uneven temperatures, and outdated equipment often create frustration for property owners. Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc. in Hackensack, NJ, provides dependable HVAC solutions designed to improve comfort, efficiency, and indoor air quality for residential and commercial properties. Call (201) 488-8002 today to schedule professional heating and cooling service.




Many homeowners and business owners wait too long before addressing HVAC issues. Small problems often become expensive repairs if systems are ignored. Weak airflow, noisy equipment, and poor temperature control may also affect comfort and energy efficiency over time. Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc helps customers avoid those problems through professional HVAC installation, repair, maintenance, and system design services.


HVAC Services Backed by Decades of Experience

Reliable HVAC service requires experience, proper training, and attention to detail. Since 1989, Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc. has continued helping residential and commercial customers maintain dependable heating and cooling systems.




The company is family-owned, licensed, and insured while proudly serving Bergen County and the greater tri-county area.


Customers rely on the company for:

Residential HVAC services

Commercial HVAC services

Heating installation and repair

Air conditioning services

Indoor air quality solutions

Ductwork design and fabrication

HVAC maintenance plans

The company also holds certifications as a Rheem Team Top Contractor and Mitsubishi Elite Diamond Dealer.﻿

Every project focuses on long-term comfort, system performance, and dependable service.


Heating And Cooling Services for Year-Round Comfort

Heating and cooling systems play a major role in indoor comfort throughout every season. However, aging equipment and poor maintenance may reduce system performance over time.




Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc. provides complete heating and cooling services designed around the needs of each property.


Heating services include the following:

Heating installation

AC installation

Heating repair

AC repair

Heating replacement

AC replacement

Heat pump services

Cooling maintenance

Gas furnace services

Energy-efficient upgrades

Preventative maintenance

Duct design services

The company works carefully to help customers improve comfort, airflow, and energy efficiency throughout the property.

Preventative maintenance services may also help reduce future repair costs and system breakdowns.﻿

Ductless Mini Split Solutions for Flexible Comfort

Some homes and businesses struggle with rooms that stay too hot or too cold. Traditional systems may not always provide balanced airflow in every area of the property.




Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc. provides ductless mini-split systems designed for flexible heating and cooling control.




Ductless services include:


Ductless mini split installation
Ductless heating systems
Ductless cooling systems﻿
Mitsubishi ductless heat pumps
Ductless system repair
Mini split maintenance services﻿

These systems help customers improve comfort while reducing energy waste in unused spaces.




Many property owners also choose ductless systems for additions, offices, garages, and areas without existing ductwork.


Commercial HVAC And Indoor Air Quality Solutions

Commercial buildings require dependable HVAC systems to maintain comfortable environments for employees, customers, and tenants. Poor airflow and inconsistent temperatures may affect productivity and indoor comfort.




Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc provides commercial HVAC services and indoor air quality solutions for many different property types.




Commercial and indoor air quality services include:


Commercial HVAC installation
Commercial maintenance contracts
Commercial ductwork solutions
Sheet metal fabrication
Air filtration systems﻿
Whole-home humidifiers
Air purifiers
Energy recovery ventilators
REME® and PHI-cell® purification systems﻿

According to the Environmental Protection Agency, indoor air quality may directly affect comfort and overall indoor environmental conditions.




The company helps customers improve airflow, ventilation, and indoor comfort through dependable HVAC solutions.

Why Customers Choose Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc

Customers want HVAC contractors who communicate clearly and complete work correctly. Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc. continues building strong customer relationships through dependable service and professional workmanship.




Customers continue choosing the company because it offers:


Family-owned local service
Residential and commercial expertise
Licensed and insured technicians
HVAC design and fabrication solutions﻿
Maintenance plans
Certified HVAC professionals
Reliable scheduling and communication

The company proudly serves Bergen County and the greater tri county area with professional heating, cooling, ductwork, and indoor air quality services.




No matter the size of the project, Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc. work hard to provide HVAC solutions customers can trust year-round.

Call (201) 488-8002 today to schedule professional HVAC service.

A Family-Owned HVAC Company Built on Reliable Service
About Us.

2nd generation family-owned and operated core values and unmatched work ethic, small, deliberate, and reliable (the saying things aren’t built the way they used to be may apply to the product purchased, but it DOESN'T APPLY to this team) The product may have changed, but the foundation of this team has NOT.




Founded in 1993 on a mission to provide climate control solutions with customer service and honesty as the method in which we deliver.


We are a family-owned and operated business; customer service and dependability are how this organization was built. We pride ourselves on high-end retrofits with custom duct designs to high-efficiency upgrades. We started out of a garage; our home office and single van have grown into a household name serving the tri-county area. The foundation of customer service and honest consultations is the exact value that has given this company the ability to be of service to more residents each day. In the words of the president, "Treat each home as if it were yours and each client like family." As we enter into our 33rd year of business, our services and solutions to deliver the ultimate comfort have evolved with the new demand for efficiencies and individual climate solutions within a single home; however, the way in which we are delivering has not budged a single inch. Call today to schedule your free in-home consultation for all your climate control needs. We can’t wait to hear from you.


Professional Service with A Customer-First Approach

Customers want HVAC contractors they can trust inside their home or business. Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc. focus on honest communication, reliable scheduling, and professional workmanship during every project.

﻿

The company believes quality service should include:


Clear communication
Dependable repairs
Proper HVAC system design

Attention to detail
Long-term comfort solutions
Respect for the customer’s property﻿

Whether the project involves a simple repair or a full HVAC installation, the company approaches every job with professionalism and care.

﻿

Customers continue to rely on Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc. because the team focuses on doing the work correctly the first time.


Helping The Community Stay Comfortable Year-Round

For decades, Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc has continued helping residential and commercial customers maintain dependable heating and cooling systems throughout the area.

﻿

The company proudly serves Bergen County and the larger tri-county area by providing:


Residential HVAC services
Commercial HVAC services
Indoor air quality solutions﻿
Ductless mini split systems
HVAC maintenance plans
Custom ductwork design﻿

No matter the size of the project, Duct Mate Air Conditioning and Heating Inc. remains committed to providing dependable service and long-term comfort solutions customers can trust.


Call (201) 488-8002 today to learn more about the company and schedule HVAC service.
